description: Informal forum reply tells a user with a game crash to paste an mshta command from a raw IP into Win+R and to disable antivirus.
rationale: The reply pushes the reader to run a remote HTA script and pre-emptively explains away the antivirus warning, a typical social-engineering lure hidden among genuine help.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
